project_type: Next.js 16.2.4 App Router with React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4
build_system: bun (npm scripts via bun). Note: npm/node are NOT directly available; use bun exclusively.
test_framework: No test framework configured yet. Use bun run build for validation.
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'bun run build' to verify the app compiles without errors. 2. Run 'bun run lint' to check for linting issues.
setup_instructions: Run 'bun install' in /projects/sandbox/kiro-web-playground to install dependencies. Dependencies are already installed.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. bun 1.2.14 is available. npm/node/npx are NOT available - use 'bun' and 'bunx' instead. This is Next.js 16 which uses proxy.ts instead of middleware.ts. Read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ for API details.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md: This is NOT the Next.js you know. This version has breaking changes. Read the relevant guide in node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing any code. Use proxy.ts (not middleware.ts). Use responsive Tailwind CSS utility classes. Use semantic HTML for all layout sections.
key_patterns: Next.js 16 App Router patterns: Server Components by default, Client Components with 'use client' directive, Server Actions with 'use server', useActionState for form state, proxy.ts for route protection (replaces middleware.ts), cookies() API from 'next/headers' for session cookies, jose library for JWT encryption. Tailwind CSS 4 uses @import 'tailwindcss' (already configured in globals.css).
directory_structure: Root: app/ (App Router pages/layouts), public/ (static assets). App uses path alias @/* mapped to ./*. Tailwind CSS 4 configured via postcss.config.mjs with @tailwindcss/postcss plugin.
